snippet.title: Magical Thief Silky / 怪盗シルキー PV1
snippet.description:
Steam Store Page:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3693310/

Shoot and slash your way through a perilous urban underbelly to save kidnapped magical fish! Swap between Silky-sama and her oddball friend to fell enemies with swords, guns, and a plethora of stolen skills in this quirky 2D action platformer with dramatic finishing moves!
